newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $105/dressed, light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $105/dressed, light - USDA.

text.p: Trade was only moderate at best, USDA said. Prices on slaughter steers and heifers steady with Monday's decline on both live and dressed basis sales.Buyer inquiry good, seller interest mixed.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs few 64.75 in far western part of state; Dressed basis sales 104.00, some 105.00 early.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1175 lbs few 64.00; Dressed basis sales 104.00. Confirmed - 1,700 For the week - 31,600
